description: CPU, RAM, disk, HA service, backup, restore, load, and availability for eight VSS skill-eval coordinators.

panels.title: Hosts reporting (last 2m)
panels.description: Must remain at 8. A lower value means at least one Telegraf agent stopped reporting.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -2m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.fleet == "vss-skill-eval-distributed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vss_ha_probe" and r._field == "heartbeat")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["coordinator_id"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "coordinator_id")
  |> count(column: "coordinator_id")

panels.title: CPU active
panels.description: Latest active CPU percentage by coordinator.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.fleet == "vss-skill-eval-distributed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.coordinator_id =~ /^${coordinator:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_active")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.cpu == "cpu-total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["coordinator_id"])
